summary: Bug 1 fix is INCOMPLETE — the 360° persona quiz STILL triggers for users with is_onboarding_complete=True on a fresh tina_sessions doc. Root cause confirmed by code review AND live API test: at /app/backend/tina_service.py line 941, `p360 = _get_360_state(session)` returns a COPY of the state dict. Then on line 945, `_set_360_state(session, {phase:'complete',...})` mutates the SESSION but the local variable `p360` is left STALE pointing at the original (inactive) dict. The very next branches on lines 964 (`if p360['phase'] == 'inactive':`) and 973 (`if p360['phase'] == 'active':`) check the stale local — so when the session starts in 'inactive' (any user who never started the quiz), the code STILL falls into `_begin_360_quiz(...)` and returns a scripted question. Verified live: turn 1 of a fresh complete user returns show_options.mode='personality_360', question_id='first_night_vibe' and persona_360_phase='active'. Bug 2 (fast=True / gpt-4o-mini swap + frontend cadence constants) is CORRECTLY APPLIED — latency averaged 1.45s over 3 trials (well below the 2.5s target, was previously 3-5s with gpt-4o), the `fast: bool = False` param and `model_name = 'gpt-4o-mini' if fast else 'gpt-4o'` branch are present, the post-onboarding call passes `fast=True`, and TinaCallScreen.tsx has SILENCE=700, MIN_SPEECH=500, METERING=80, PRE_REPLY_PAUSE=0. Regression: test_supabase_audit 13/13 PASS, test_audit_iter20 20/20 PASS, test_real_user_matchmaking 4/6 (2 pre-existing failures from iter25 — top_n=15 matchmaking cap, NOT touched by this fix). A SECOND bug surfaced: when is_onboarding_complete=True and user_message='' (chip-only payload, e.g. `selected_option:'Casual movie buff'`), the code falls through to scripted ONBOARDING (asks 'relationshipIntent') — see line 985: `if actually_complete and user_message:` — empty message skips the free-chat path and lands in the legacy field-collection scripted flow at line 1097+.

critical.issue:
Bug 1 fix INCOMPLETE — 360° quiz still triggers for is_onboarding_complete=True users. Root cause: stale `p360` local variable at /app/backend/tina_service.py:941. The code calls `_set_360_state(session, {'phase':'complete',...})` on lines 945-952 to force completion in-memory, but the local `p360` dict captured on line 941 is NOT re-read. Lines 964 (`if p360['phase'] == 'inactive':`) and 973 (`if p360['phase'] == 'active':`) then check the stale value and call `_begin_360_quiz` or `_handle_360_turn`, returning a scripted quiz question. Live evidence (turn 1 of fresh complete user): response='Okay Alice Test your profile's looking 🔥

Now help me understand you better — a quick fun round so I can find you the perfect match 💫

If you matched tonight, what's most likely to happen first?', show_options.mode='personality_360', persona_360_phase='active'.

Secondary Bug — chip-only payload (message='', selected_option='Casual movie buff', is_onboarding_complete=True) routes into scripted ONBOARDING (field='relationshipIntent', completion_percentage=0) instead of free-chat LLM. Root cause: line 985 `if actually_complete and user_message:` — empty user_message short-circuits the LLM path and falls through to scripted field-collection at line 1097. The review request explicitly required this case to NOT enter quiz/scripted state.

     ```

                                  'answers': _get_360_state(session).get('answers', [])})
         p360 = _get_360_state(session)   # ← RE-READ here
     ```

Recommend Option B above — the signup TinaChatScreen (per the code comment on line 937-939) already runs the 360 quiz inline during mandatory onboarding, so the post-onboarding path should NEVER run quiz handlers. Removing those two branches is safer than keeping the in-memory force + re-read pattern.

rca_of_issue: Bug 1: /app/backend/tina_service.py:941 captures `p360 = _get_360_state(session)` (a new dict). Lines 945-952 call `_set_360_state(session, {'phase':'complete', ...})` which mutates `session['personality_360']` but NOT the local `p360`. Lines 964 and 973 then evaluate `p360['phase']` against the STALE value. For a brand-new user (no prior personality_360 in session), `p360['phase'] == 'inactive'` is True → `_begin_360_quiz(session, result, user_name)` is called → result['show_options'] is set to the personality_360 chips → user sees the SAME scripted question Tina has always shown post-signup. Reproduction: POST /api/tina/chat {user_id:<fresh user>, message:'hello', is_onboarding_complete:true} → response.show_options.mode='personality_360', persona_360_phase='active'. Fix (recommended Option B): delete lines 964-980 entirely. The signup TinaChatScreen already runs the 360 quiz during mandatory onboarding (per the inline code comment), so the post-onboarding /api/tina/chat path must NEVER invoke quiz handlers. Fix Option A (minimal change): insert `p360 = _get_360_state(session)` immediately after line 952 to refresh the local variable. Secondary bug (empty-message fallthrough at line 985): `if actually_complete and user_message:` skips the LLM branch on empty messages, dropping the request into the scripted onboarding fall-through at line 1097+. Reproduction: POST {message:'', selected_option:'Casual movie buff', is_onboarding_complete:true} → response.show_options.field='relationshipIntent', completion_percentage=0. Fix: coerce `selected_option` / `selected_options` into `user_message` at the top of the `if actually_complete:` block.
